name: @tradew/database
description: Single Prisma schema + migration history — the one schema owner for Postgres (ARCHITECTURE.md §1.4). Also owns the at-rest encryption format for BrokerCredential.accessToken (src/credential-crypto.ts).

scripts.//admin:reconcile: Withdraw application-admin access in bulk. Audit-only with no arguments; dry-run with --keep; writes only with --apply. Cleanup for the unfiltered updateMany in the removed create-admin.ts, which made every account an admin. Never grants — that stays admin:grant.
scripts.//agents:seed: Create the NIFTY and SENSEX autonomous paper agents, DISARMED. Arming stays a separate console act on top of PAPER_EXECUTION_ENABLED.
scripts.//credential:migrate: Backfill: encrypt any BrokerCredential.accessToken still stored in plaintext. Dry-run by default — see scripts/encrypt-broker-credentials.ts.
